checks.message: Provisional geometry is labelled in narrative, figures, HTML, assumptions, and source tiers.
Narrative, figures, projects, and matrices use the authored spatial feature IDs.
Land-use polygons cover SITE-001 without overlap under spatial review.
ZZY, ORG, and DZS have different spatial types, component sets, scenarios, and project gates.
MAIN-IF-01 and PARALLEL-HUMAN-01 are continuous design paths inside the provisional frame.
Every automated scenario declares human review and a no-device fallback.
SC-01..SC-12 declare host, project, minimum-data rule, operator, stop rule, and metric in the package.
No public-space identity recognition or personal behaviour ranking is proposed.
Each phase requires public-path, accessibility, data, operations, and professional gates.
Chinese and English Markdown, HTML, PNG, and PDF display artifacts have different bytes.
A3 booklets contain 12 pages per language and A0 sets contain multiple non-empty pages.
Offline visual pages contain no remote resource, form, tracking, API call, or iframe.
Formal, background, and provisional sources have explicit usage limits.
Authorship, external references, system fonts, and prohibited reuse are recorded by asset class.
Spatial-review values match registered core metrics within tolerance.
Each requirement and depth item cites its narrowest section, feature, metric, source, assumption, and check.
